notes: Overwhelmingly clean: ~94% of flags are false positives because the auditor surfaces every sub-piece of a larger LEGO (Gujarati postpositions/pronoun-clitics like એ, છે, હું, માં glossed contextually as 'the/at/on/I'm/I'd' inside bigger phrases) plus English-target morphology (article a/an, tense said/started, number question(s), prep on-morning, subject ellipsis, Q/statement word-order) — none drilled bare. The only genuine learner-facing issues are the obligation construction (શું તમારે ...નું છે / મારે ...નું છે) drilled inconsistently as both 'have (got) to' and 'do you have to'/'I need to' (consolidate to one have-to form course-wide), the recurring find-out/know fork on જાણવા at BUILD and USE (differentiate), and two single-row mistranslations.
